--all-fields.help: Return all fields, irrespective of their contents

--analysis.help: display only analysis results, not the macro source code

--attr.help: display the attribute lines at the beginning of VBA source code

--code.help: display only VBA source code, do not analyze it

--dde-only.help: Return only DDE and DDEAUTO fields

--decode.help: display all the obfuscated strings with their decoded content (Hex, Base64, StrReverse, Dridex, VBA).

--detailed.help: detailed mode, display full results (default for single file)

--extract.help: Extracts the embedded SWF(s), names it MD5HASH.swf &

--filter.help: Return all fields except harmless ones

--header.help: Displays the SWFs file header. No addition args needed

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--json.help: Output in json format. Do not use with -ldebug

--md5scan.help: Scans the SWF(s) for MD5 signatures. Please see func

--more-input.help: Additional file to parse (same as positional arguments)

--no-pcode.help: Disable extraction and analysis of pcode

--no-xlm.help: Do not extract XLM Excel macros. This may speed up analysis of large files.

--ole.help: Parse an OLE file (e.g. Word, Excel) to look for SWF

--password.help: if encrypted office files are encountered, try decryption with this password. May be repeated.

--relaxed.help: Do not raise errors if opening of substream fails (this option is now deprecated, enabled by default)

--reveal.help: display the macro source code after replacing all the obfuscated strings by their decoded content.

--rtf.help: Parse an RTF file to look for SWF in each embedded
